targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS total_events FROM events
SELECT count(*) AS upcoming_events FROM events WHERE datum >= CURRENT_DATE
SELECT count(*) AS locations FROM locations
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE lat IS NOT NULL AND lon IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS geocoded_percent FROM locations
SELECT count(*) AS missing_coordinates FROM locations WHERE lat IS NULL OR lon IS NULL
SELECT COALESCE(max(datum), CURRENT_DATE) AS latest_event_date FROM events
SELECT datum::timestamp AS time, 'events' AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE datum >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60 days' GROUP BY datum ORDER BY datum
SELECT COALESCE(source, 'unknown') AS source, GREATEST(max(datum) - CURRENT_DATE, 0) AS days_ahead FROM events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY days_ahead DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT CASE WHEN lat IS NULL OR lon IS NULL THEN 'missing coordinates' ELSE 'has coordinates' END AS status, count(*) AS locations FROM locations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY locations DESC

SELECT COALESCE(e.source, 'unknown') AS source, count(*) AS events FROM events e JOIN locations l ON l.id = e.location_id WHERE e.datum >= CURRENT_DATE AND (l.lat IS NULL OR l.lon IS NULL) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT label, value FROM (VALUES ('missing title', (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE thema IS NULL OR trim(thema) = '')), ('missing category', (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE category IS NULL OR trim(category) = '')), ('missing description', (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE description IS NULL OR trim(description) = '')), ('missing image', (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE image_url IS NULL OR trim(image_url) = ''))) AS metrics(label, value) ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT name AS location, district, lat AS latitude, lon AS longitude, geocoded_at FROM locations ORDER BY geocoded_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 30
SELECT name AS location, COALESCE(plz, '') AS plz, COALESCE(district, '') AS district, geocoded_at FROM locations WHERE lat IS NULL OR lon IS NULL ORDER BY geocoded_at DESC NULLS LAST, name LIMIT 50
